title: Monday morning payroll batch overload
demo_purpose: Recurrence and time pattern: five Monday morning incidents since March 2026, the same failure fixed once in 2025.
time_pattern: Mondays between 06:00 and 08:30 UTC, during the weekly payroll batch

title: Payment API connection leak after v4.18.2
demo_purpose: The reference case: a deployment 34 minutes before detection, clear logs, a matching past RCA, and two innocent changes in the window.

title: Customer Portal session errors after a regional failover (no useful history)
demo_purpose: No past RCA and no similar incident. One innocent change in the window. The application should report weak support and ask for more evidence, not invent a cause.

title: API Gateway wildcard certificate expired
demo_purpose: A matching past RCA from 2024, an innocent patching change the night before, and a cause (a credential rotation) older than the search window.

title: Settlement consumer stuck on an incompatible message
demo_purpose: A misleading past RCA: same service, same symptoms (consumer lag, rebalances), different cause. The cause is a change on a dependency, found through the CMDB.

title: Month-end billing aggregation times out
demo_purpose: Second time pattern (last business day of the month) and the 'request more evidence' loop: the cause is a maintenance change 6 days before, found only with a wider window.
time_pattern: Last business day of the month, 22:00-02:00 UTC, during the month-end aggregation

title: Notification broker disk full during a campaign
demo_purpose: The obvious trigger (a campaign starting) is not the cause. The first-error rule gives no points to the campaign change, because the disk warnings started a day earlier.

title: Auth Service pods killed after a resource profile change
demo_purpose: A clear change two and a half hours before the incident; a traffic surge and a past RCA with a different cause compete as explanations.

title: Nightly reporting DNS timeouts after CoreDNS scale-down
demo_purpose: The cause is a change on a shared platform (Kubernetes CoreDNS), found only because the CMDB links the Reporting Service to it. Three nights in a row give a daily pattern.
time_pattern: Every night around 05:00 UTC, when the nightly report batch starts

title: User Profile contract field reused after v3.2
demo_purpose: The same kind of failure a year apart: a matching past RCA plus a deployment 35 minutes before detection.

title: Merchant webhooks blocked after a vendor IP change
demo_purpose: The deployment the day of the incident is innocent: the failures started 43 minutes before it. The real cause (a vendor IP change and our egress allowlist) is outside the sources, so the application should not reach HIGH and should list what it could not check.

title: Customer Portal origin overload after a CDN rule change
demo_purpose: Two changes 15 minutes apart were rolled back together. The logs show which one came first: the CDN hit ratio falls before the portal release.

title: Session store evictions after a token lifetime change (log gap)
demo_purpose: Logs are missing for most of the incident (log shipper upgrade). The first investigation should be weak and list the gap; a second one with a 7 day window finds the memory growth and the change.
